identity.fantasy: A feral blood-cursed hunter who abandons careful spellcasting for fangs, pursuit, and short violent transformations.
identity.one_line: A feral blood hunter using Accursed Form, bites, Reave, Veinburst, Bloodsurge, and Dark Frenzy. It is fast, mobile, and self-sustaining, with a clearer melee priority loop than Sanguine's spell package.

mechanics.core_loop: Fight in Accursed Form, use Reave and bite attacks to sustain pressure, trigger Veinburst and Bloodsurge payoffs, and align Dark Frenzy or later hunting talents with targets that can survive the burst.

modes.name: Accursed Form
modes.structural_description: Transform: s your Blood Curse into Accursed Form.Accursed Form (Cursed Form)Embrace your demonic curse for 30 seconds, entering an improved Cursed Form, increasing your attack power by 50% of your Agility and causing your melee attacks to reduce all healing done to the target by -20% for 10 seconds, stacking 2 times.

modes.name: Unchained
modes.structural_description: Level 10 PassiveYour damaging Mortal Form spells can now be cast while moving.

modes.name: Veinburst
modes.structural_description: Requires Mortal FormBlast an enemy, dealing 123 + 25% AP + 85% shadow SP Shadow damage.Deals 25% increased damage to bleeding targets.

modes.name: Aortic Assault
modes.structural_description: Extend the duration of your active Cursed Form by 3 sec and strike nearby enemies every 1 sec for 3 seconds, each strike causing 20 + 12% AP Physical damage.

modes.name: Sanguine Scripture
modes.structural_description: Upon exiting Accursed Form, you gain 70% movement speed and spell haste for 5 seconds.

modes.name: Gore Tome
modes.structural_description: For the first 5 sec after activating a Cursed Form, your Bloodfang Bite is now guaranteed to critically strike.

modes.name: Bloodsurge
modes.structural_description: Requires Mortal FormEnter a bloodsurge, enraging you and increasing your Shadow damage dealt and your spell critical strike chance by 20% for 20 seconds.At the end of the duration, or whenever you trigger Accursed Form, gain Bloodchaser instead.BloodchaserEnrage, increasing your Physical Damage dealt by 20% for 30 secondsWhile active, Bloodfang Bite now launches 1 Blood Shard, dealing 18 + 15% AP + 35% SP Shadow Damage to your target.

modes.name: Crimson Feast
modes.structural_description: Every 5 second you remain in a Cursed Form now reduces the cooldown of your Bloodsurge by -5 sec.

modes.name: Dark Frenzy
modes.structural_description: Increases spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.In addition, while a Cursed Form is active, your global cooldowns are reduced by -25%.

modes.name: One Man's Curse...
modes.structural_description: Removes the health cost of Accursed Form and entering it now instantly restores 15% of your maximum health.

modes.name: Battleweaver
modes.structural_description: Casting Cursed Form abilities now has a 50% chance to generate 1 Blood Shard for 10 minutes, up to 8.Dealing damage with Bloodbolt will launch 1 Blood Shard, dealing 18 + 15% AP + 35% SP Arcane damage to your target.

modes.name: Blood Scent
modes.structural_description: While in Accursed Form, you now deal 15% increased damage to targets below 35% maximum health.Dealing direct damage to enemies below 35% maximum health now leeches health equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

modes.name: The Hunter and the Hunted
modes.structural_description: Level 50 PassiveWhen you activate a Cursed Form you now charge to your target if they are within 20 yds. If they're an enemy you root them for 2 seconds.Upon expiration, your Accursed Form can be reactivated to cause you to erupt in a burst of blood magic, leeching 364 + 33% shadow SP + 12.5% AP health from nearby enemies and teleporting you backwards.

modes.name: Hemoburst
modes.structural_description: Requires Mortal FormUnleash a powerful burst of blood at an enemy, dealing 1480 + 65% AP + 50% SP Shadow damage. This ability is guaranteed to critically strike against bleeding targets.Extends the duration of your next Cursed Form by 5 sec for 30 seconds, stacking 2 times.

modes.name: Final Embrace
modes.structural_description: Requires Mortal FormGorge on blood magic, entering a dramatically improved Cursed Form for 20 seconds, transforming your Bloodfang Bite into Crimson Maw, but draining your health over time.While active, every 1 sec you curse enemies within 8 yds, applying Hematoma for 6 seconds.Hematoma (Shadow Damage)Deals 55 + 15% shadow SP + 10% AP Shadow Damage and increases the damage the target takes from subsequent applications of Hematoma by 3%, stacking 10 times. Generates Rage based on damage dealt.

mechanics.single_target: Maintain the form and its bite-and-Reave priority, then exploit Bloodsurge, Dark Frenzy, and level-50 hunting effects for focused pressure.
mechanics.aoe: Veinburst, Gore Barrage, and Hemoburst add pack tools, but the specialization remains more naturally focused than Sanguine's spreading spell package.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Dark Hunt, pursuit effects, and the melee form support rapid target access; switching is less punishing than abandoning a long DoT stack, though burst windows can still be wasted.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Bites, leeching effects, Clotting, and Endure the Curse provide recovery, while fear and Bloodmage control supplement the melee chase.
mechanics.group_utility: Most specialization value is personal damage and sustain; Bloodmage class tools still contribute control and off-healing.

failure_modes.text: Entering or spending a transformation window without enough target uptime wastes the spec's strongest sequence.

Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: dark hunt, pursuit effects, and the melee form support rapid target access; switching is less punishing than abandoning a long dot stack, though burst windows can still be wasted.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: bites, leeching effects, clotting, and endure the curse provide recovery, while fear and bloodmage control supplement the melee chase.

enjoy_if.text: You want Bloodmage fantasy expressed through an aggressive mobile melee form rather than long caster setup.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: fight in accursed form, use reave and bite attacks to sustain pressure, trigger veinburst and bloodsurge payoffs, and align dark frenzy or later hunting talents with targets that can survive the burst.

avoid_if.text: You want a proven smooth early leveling curve or a passive ranged attrition loop.

You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that dark hunt, pursuit effects, and the melee form support rapid target access; switching is less punishing than abandoning a long dot stack, though burst windows can still be wasted.

praise.theme: The structural identity promises fast melee pursuit and a more readable priority than Sanguine.

frustrations.theme: Recent leveling players describe Accursed as late-blooming, squishy, and weak before the 40s.

contested.theme: The July DPS snapshot places Accursed above several Bloodmage alternatives, which conflicts with the poor leveling reports but covers a different level and context.

gaps: No detailed current level-60 rotation guide.
The leveling-to-endgame improvement point needs broader confirmation.

claims.text: A July 30 Bloodmage leveling discussion strongly discourages Accursed for solo leveling and says it takes more than 40 levels to feel functional, citing low damage, weak physical defense, and mediocre single-target self-healing.
claims.notes: Small, strongly opinionated thread; it does not prove endgame weakness.

claims.text: The July community DPS compilation reports Accursed at 4,477, while the August Mythic inventory lists 36 uploaded Accursed records.
claims.notes: DPS methodology is incomplete and upload count measures representation, not power.

claims.text: Accursed is a mobile melee priority specialization whose complexity comes from preserving target uptime during form and frenzy windows.
claims.notes: Playstyle classification, not an official label.

claims.text: Accursed loses a material portion of its payoff when movement or control prevents melee contact during Dark Frenzy and related hunt windows.
claims.notes: The loss magnitude is not measured.

claims.text: Recent levelers advise delaying open-world transformation until roughly level 40, kiting with DoTs and Bloodmoon Blast early, and using the later form for tank-supported large-pull AoE; reports remain sharply mixed.
claims.notes: Manually reviewed on 2026-08-06; anecdotal evidence is not treated as a power ranking.
